description: Overrides of the environment variables that common sets on every container. Each key replaces the value of `TZ`, `securityContext.container.UMASK`, `securityContext.container.PUID` or `containerOptions.NVIDIA_CAPS` for this container.

NVIDIA_CAPS.description: Capabilities of the NVIDIA driver that are made available (`NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES`), for containers that use an `nvidia.com/gpu` resource. Allowed entries are `all`, `compute`, `utility`, `graphics` and `video`, and entries must be unique. Defaults to `containerOptions.NVIDIA_CAPS`.

TZ.description: Time zone of the container (`TZ`). Defaults to the top-level `TZ` value.

UMASK.description: File creation mask of the container (`UMASK` and `UMASK_SET`). Defaults to `securityContext.container.UMASK`.

PUID.description: User ID of the container (`PUID`), used by images that drop privileges themselves. Defaults to `securityContext.container.PUID`.
